The '''30-5 sublight engine''', manufactured by [[Sepma]], was the primary sublight drive for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], which had two of these units.<ref name="CS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
